articles.title: Crypto exchange MNX takes on OKX, Bitget offering pre-IPO futures for AI giants
articles.snippet: MNX is offering a different way to trade the future valuations of private AI companies, including OpenAI, Anthropic and DeepSeek.

articles.title: Bitcoin diverges from South Korean stocks as AI concerns deepen the Kospi selloff
articles.snippet: South Korea’s chipmakers lead another sharp selloff as concerns over AI spending and Chinese competition grow, while bitcoin holds well above its summer lows.

articles.title: Palantir's Europe head warns the region is 'missing the boat' on AI just as it did with the internet
articles.snippet: The Palantir UK chief said the U.S. is racing ahead on enterprise AI while Europe hesitates, and explained why he thinks the company faces intense political attacks.

articles.title: Tom Lee sees $2 trillion wealth transfer fueling crypto demand as Bitmine buys more ether
articles.snippet: The Bitmine chairman said he expects younger investors to drive demand for digital assets as his ether treasury company inches closer to owning 5% of the total supply.

articles.title: Global financial watchdog calls for cross-border information sharing, planning for stablecoin crisis
articles.snippet: Coins jointly issued by multiple companies can trap reserves in one jurisdiction while redemption demands hit another, complicating cross-border crisis response.
